subject: general
question: X can do a certain work in 84 days. Y is 50% less efficient than X while Z takes 28 days to do the same work. To complete the work, Y started the work, X joined him after 3 days and Z joined them after 7 days from the beginning. For how many days did Z work to complete the work?
solution:
**Given :**

X does a work in 84 days

Y does the same work with 50 % less efficiency i.e., in 168 days 

And Z takes 28 days to do the same work

**Calculations :**

1 Day work of X = (1)/(84) th part of work 

1 Day work of Y = (1)/(168) th part of work

1 Day work of Z = (1)/(28) th part of work

1 Day work of X and Y together = (1)/(84)+(1)/(168)=(1)/(56) th part of work

1 Day work of X , Y and Z together = (1)/(84)+(1)/(168)+(1)/(28) = (3)/(56) th part of work

For 3 days , Y worked alone and completed = 3×(1)/(68) = (1)/(56) th part of work

For next 4 days , X and Y worked together and completed = 4×(1)/(56) = (1)/(14) th part of work 

Now , remaining work after 7 days

⇒ [ 1 - { (1)/(56)+(1)/(14) } ]

⇒ 1 - ((5)/(56))

⇒ ((51)/(56)) the part of work

The remaining work is done by joined team of X , Y and Z in 

⇒ (51)/(56)×(56)/(3)

⇒ 17 days 

**Hence , Z works for 17 days to complete the work.**
